findings.friction_name: persona detours through an unexpected account-type modal before completing plan selection
findings.narrative: free-tier-user's record correctly computes step=2, the next not-yet-completed happy-path step at the time of the detour (last_completed_step=1).

findings.friction_name: persona detours through an unexpected account-type modal before completing plan selection
findings.narrative: willing-to-pay-user's record WRONGLY sets step=1 (the last_completed_step value) instead of step=2 (the next_pending_step value) for the identical account-type-modal detour free-tier-user correctly recorded at step=2 — a violation of F147/CR3-2. Because the two records' `step` fields now differ, their identity tuples diverge, they fail to merge, and the same underlying friction is silently reported as two convergence_tier=1 findings instead of one convergence_tier=2 finding — exactly the cross-persona-merge collapse F147 exists to prevent.
